title: Coso core M2+ rate changes had no clear contrast with surrounding rates between 2013-2018 and 2020-2025
abstract: We tested later earthquake rates in a fixed Coso core and the rest of a nearby box. We used a shared ComCat snapshot from 10 November 2026. The core is within 4 km of 36.03 N, 117.80 W. At magnitude 2 or more, the core has 44 events in 2013-2018 and 52 in 2020-2025. The surrounding box has 79 and 120 events. The ratio of core and surrounding rate changes is 0.778. The conditional 95% annual bootstrap interval is 0.469 to 1.677. Exact enumeration gives 0.472 to 1.661. Two- and three-year block intervals also cross 1. This gives no clear relative change in the primary sample. A magnitude 1.5 check gives a lower ratio, while a magnitude 2.5 check is above 1 with wide uncertainty. These checks share events and have no multiple-test adjustment. Small counts, six years per period, catalog detection, region choice and a changing surrounding rate limit inference. Total later counts do not measure the known 2019 triggering deficit or stress recovery. The package contains code, aggregate evidence, a figure, exact source hashes and a retrieval method. Raw records and annual count tables remain external.

display.caption: Annual M2+ counts and ratios of core and surrounding rate changes. The core is within 4 km of 36.03 N, 117.80 W. The box is 35.95-36.15 N and 117.90-117.70 W. The left axis uses a log scale. The right panel gives conditional 95% annual bootstrap intervals. The primary ratio is 0.778 with an interval of 0.469 to 1.677. Checks share events. Credit: USGS, ANSS ComCat and contributing networks.
